notes: Search Engine Selection: Choose your preferred default search engine from Google, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Bing, Yandex, Gerdoo, or ChatGPT in the new Search settings tab.
Quick Engine Commands: Type @ or @<engine> (e.g., @chatgpt, @brave) in the search bar to search on any provider on the fly with live suggestions.
Unified Suggestions UI: Redesigned search dropdown items with a clean, consistent two-line layout and clear badges for commands, bookmarks, and history.
Search Behavior: Added an option to open search queries and results in a new tab.
Bookmark Behavior: Added an option to open bookmarks, favorites, and folder sites in a new tab.
Bookmarks Settings: Bookmarks settings are now more organized, making it simpler to manage your shortcuts, folders, and display options.
Pomodoro Daily Summary: View a circular progress ring separating your focus, short break, and long break times in your daily summary.
Firefox Smoothness: Refined bookmark and shortcut animations to make the hover experience feel much smoother in Firefox.
